title: The Night the Old Lines Broke
date: Belfast · 1998 · Three days after the ceasefire
speaker: Resistance Briefing
lines: Armoured craft descended over Belfast and sealed the city before either side had learned how to live with peace.
Ruairí had carried messages through the republican streets. Davy guarded the road across the peace wall. The occupation took both neighbourhoods, so the old enemies built one resistance.

You are Ruairí. These are not undead and this is not an outbreak: an organised invasion force holds homes, civilians and the route to Divis. Breach their cordons, get people out and take the city back one street at a time.

speaker: Ruairí
lines: Never thought I'd fight beside an Orangeman.
Aye well, needs must. Their tanks don't check your chapel.

speaker: Davy
lines: Door comes down the same whether God's a Prod or not.

speaker: Ruairí
lines: You took a round meant for me back there, Davy.
Don't make it weird. Two streets left, then we never speak again.

speaker: Davy
lines: When this is done, the peelers'll want the both of us.
Then we'll boot them out an' all. One door at a time.
